title: Uss recovery agent ki aawaz kyun jaani-pehchaani thi? | Anhoni #shorts

characters.ramesh: 50-year-old Indian man, tired lean face, wheatish skin with deep worry lines, greying short hair combed back, salt-pepper stubble, wearing a faded light-blue cotton kameez slightly wrinkled, thin steel wristwatch on left hand; distinctive feature: a small mole above his right eyebrow and heavy dark circles under sunken eyes.
characters.rohit: 24-year-old Indian man, round youthful face, fair-wheatish skin, neat short black hair, clean-shaven, wearing a formal navy-blue call-center shirt with a white plastic ID card on a red lanyard, black wireless headset with mic on his head; distinctive feature: same small mole above his right eyebrow as Ramesh.

music_prompt: dark cinematic suspense background music, sorrowful and tense, slow rising strings, no vocals, no drums

panels.text: Sir, teen din ruk jao... biwi ICU me hai.
panels.prompt: Close-up of Ramesh sitting on a plastic chair in a dim hospital corridor at night, phone pressed to his ear, face pale and pleading, one hand clutching a folded medical bill; harsh tube-light overhead, blurred ICU signboard behind.

panels.text: Sirf Rs 15,000... itni si baat pe itni gaali?
panels.prompt: Ramesh alone on a hospital bench, staring at his cheap phone screen showing a loan app logo, shoulders slumped, ashamed expression, night window reflection behind him, cold blue lighting.

panels.text: Photo mat bhejo mohalle me... please.
panels.prompt: Ramesh standing near a hospital exit door, gripping phone with both hands close to his chest, eyes wet and terrified, a threatening message notification glowing on screen; dark parking lot visible outside.

panels.text: Paisa do warna family badnaam ho jayegi.
panels.prompt: Wide shot of Rohit seated in a crowded call-center cubicle under white LED lights, headset on, reading coldly off a dual-monitor screen, ID card on red lanyard, robotic blank expression, rows of agents blurred behind.

panels.text: Bas ek aur target... phir ghar paisa bhejunga.
panels.prompt: Rohit leaning back in his office chair for a second, tired but determined, glancing at a whiteboard reading 'DAILY RECOVERY TARGET', a small family photo taped near his monitor; harsh corporate lighting.

panels.text: Beta, main bhi kisi ka baap hoon.
panels.prompt: Ramesh crouched against a hospital wall on the floor, phone at his ear, broken and crying softly, one hand covering his face; empty midnight corridor stretching behind, single flickering light.

panels.text: Emotional drama band karo. Naam bolo.
panels.prompt: Rohit typing on keyboard, still cold, headset mic near his lips, defaulter details form open on screen; the cursor hovering over an empty name field, tense over-the-shoulder angle.
Ramesh whispering his name into the phone, exhausted and defeated, dark circles heavy under his eyes; the mole above his right eyebrow clearly visible under the tube-light glow.

Extreme close-up of Rohit frozen in shock, mouth open, eyes wide and horrified, hand slowly rising toward his headset; monitor screen reflecting the name 'RAMESH VERMA, SITAPUR', his matching eyebrow mole catching the light.

panels.text: Jis ghar ko wo barbaad kar raha tha... wo uska apna tha.
panels.prompt: Rohit standing up in the cubicle, headset dangling from a shaking hand, staring at his father's photo pinned beside the defaulter screen; the same face on both — call-center lights suddenly feeling cold and cruel, his world collapsing.

caption:
Ramesh apni beemar biwi ke ilaaj ke liye loan leta hai... aur jo recovery agent use roz dhamka raha tha, wo uska apna beta nikla. 💔

Ab Rohit kya karega? Part 2 ke liye Follow karo.

(Kalpanik kahani — fiction, awareness ke liye.)
intro: Biwi ICU mein zindagi-maut ke beech thi, jeb khaali. Majboori mein Ramesh ne ek loan app se 15,000 liye... phir shuru hui khaufnaak recovery calls.
